messages:
maria: Heads-up: red-team dry run next Tue 09:00-12:00 PT. Need final RBAC window, KMS access plan, and an evidence upload pattern we can hand to assessors.

sam: noted. can we keep the RBAC window to 1h per env? avoids long-lived privs. :thumbsup:

jordan: +1. I'll schedule an ephemeral role that auto-revokes after 1hr. drafting the role arn and session policy now.

alexa: Quick checklist: 1) ephemeral roles for assessors 2) read-only telemetry for logs 3) presigned S3 for evidence 4) KMS decrypt only via proxy 5) audit exports to sec-account. anything else?

maria: good list. add: a small set of synthetic requests to test detection rules during dry run. also confirm log retention snapshot at 90d for the window.

eli: how do we want to handle KMS key access? assessors need to decrypt certain blobs for evidence verification. we prefer no direct KMS decrypt from their IPs.

sam: plan: create a dedicated KMS key with key policy allowing decrypt only from our proxy role. assessors get the ephemeral role that can assume proxy role via sts:AssumeRoleWithSAML for the window. no cross-account decrypt.

jordan: I put a short script for the ephemeral role creation in #eng-infra:```bash
# create ephemeral role
aws iam create-role --role-name pt-assessor-ephemeral --assume-role-policy-document file://assume.json
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name pt-assessor-ephemeral --policy-name pt-limited --policy-document file://pt-policy.json
# auto revoke via scheduled Lambda
```

alexa: For audit logging: make sure CloudTrail is in multi-region mode and we export S3 object-level logs for the timestamps. I'll open a ticket to increase export frequency for the day.

maria: Evidence packaging: prefer presigned S3 links with 24h expiry and a manifest signed by ops-bot. ops-bot, can you add a manifest signer?

ops-bot: manifest signer enabled for channel 'pt-handoff'. generated signing key id: kp-pt-2026-03. Use endpoint https://signer.redwood.internal/pt-sign.

eli: For remediation tracking — can we use a tiny Trello or GH issue per vuln with fields: status, owner, mitigations, evidence-link, retest-window? want to ensure we can handoff to product quickly.

sam: use GH issues in repo security/pt-remediations. I'll add a template and automation to tag 'ready-for-retest' when evidence link uploaded.

jordan: I'll add a shortrun playbook for SRE to snapshot logs and export to presigned S3 at start/end of window. snippet:```yaml
steps:
  - name: snapshot-cloudtrail
    run: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time $START --end-time $END > /tmp/ct-events.json
  - name: upload
    run: aws s3 cp /tmp/ct-events.json s3://pt-evidence/${THREAD_TS}-ct.json --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```

alexa: Retest coordination: propose a canary retest on Wed 10:00 internal first, then block for external on Thu if ok. keeps blast radius low.

maria: sounds good. action items: sam to publish ephemeral role docs by EOD Fri; jordan to attach log snapshot playbook; alexa to create audit-export ticket; eli to scaffold GH issues template; ops-bot to publish signer endpoint. I'll compile and send an evidence handoff doc Monday.

sam: working on role docs, pushing PR to infra/docs in ~2h.

jordan: playbook PR queued.

eli: GH template PR created under security/pt-remediations, adding sample issue.

ops-bot: presigned evidence bucket ready: s3://pt-evidence-2026, retention=180d, encryption=kms:kp-pt-2026-03.

maria: thanks all. one more: during dry run, we'll run a small vuln triage warroom at 11:30 — keep calendars flexible. :calendar:
